note: Both sets extract the same figure-label component claims and the VVC phase-screw-dislocation claim, but Set A additionally captures the supported trade-off that a higher topological charge yields a larger IWA, which Set B omits. Both sets misread the phase form as e^{iθ} where the page shows e^{ilθ}, and both repeat the 'Input beam from FSM' fact under two attribute names. Set A is therefore the more complete and faithful set.
remarks: The text layer garbles the exponent as 'eilθ'; the figure shows e^{ilθ} (topological charge l times azimuthal angle θ), so both sets' 'e^{iθ}' is a misread. Most claims in both sets are figure-label component identifications (OAPs, Fold, Mask, etc.) with bare label quotes — technically supported by the figure but of low engineering value; both sets treat them identically so they do not affect the comparison. The 'component' vs 'contains component' attribute wording is inconsistent within each set.
